premises.statement: Model only this finite road-and-frontage domain for two seconds, with no new unobserved entrant and no entry by observed vehicles outside it. The front Mitsubishi and adjacent right Mazda are explicitly retained; the Mazda is represented additionally outside this domain and outside the road boundary. Other cars deeper behind grass/hedges and in rear/right parking areas are conditionally assumed not to enter the local domain. These are falsifiable exclusions, not assertions that no other traffic exists. Follow the visible left bend without assuming a route beyond the modeled road patch.

Use conditional passenger-car dimensions: the directly observed grey Mitsubishi is 4.4 m long and 1.75 m wide; the right Mazda is 4.6 m long and 1.8 m wide. Estimate ground-center positions and orientations from apparent body extent, perspective, camera axes and tire/pavement relationships. Assume approximately locally continuous pavement height, without treating calibration as certified depth. Road vertices are an interior polygon estimated from visible curb and parking edges using this conditional scale. Pose-compensate front-left and front-right evidence using supplied acquisition metadata. This geometric prior applies throughout the declared past-alignment and future intervals.

Both vehicles appear parked in individual frontage bays. Adopt stationary bodies at their reference states. Retain a reasonable adverse variant with center displacement at most 0.15 m in any direction and yaw deviation at most 0.05 rad throughout [0,2]. These are the complete retained future modes within this conditional parked-vehicle model; a pulling-out maneuver exceeding those bounds is excluded. Each source rectangle encloses the complete oriented body throughout its whole interval, including the native t=0 body. Adverse rectangles additionally enclose the declared displacement and yaw spread. Source residuals exclude alignment residual; total object residual includes both exactly once.

Conditional on parked or near-stationary motion during this acquisition interval, bound ground speed by 0.2 m/s and displacement by 0.009 m for both retained scenarios. Transfer it to reference with a 0.5 m alignment residual including the displacement bound and visual localization error.
